scope_limit: Explicit historical lineage, installed runtime, two paid Batch2 campaign databases, closure test store and prior API fixtures. No account-wide inventory. Separate repeatable-read transactions are not a cross-store atomic fence.

deduplication.carry_rule: Original leaf dispatch events included once; carry not added to union. Payload hashes compared as well as accounting fields.

historical_rows.label: Original authorization retained fully encumbered; NOT a reconstructed provider bill
Alpha-dev 04; SQL allocation source plus durable installed grant readback

allocation.rule: Retain entire original 20 USD, additive receipts and unknown liabilities. Never sum successor caps, cloned events, or carry with its source dispatches.

runtime_source.consumer_hash_limitation: Source disk only; no introspection of Python objects already loaded by a running process.
Source disk only; no introspection of Python objects already loaded by a running process.

costing.design: Two held-out variations per family x B0/B1/M1 x six episodes x up to eight total generation calls per episode, including final/explanation/recovery; no retries outside this cap.
costing.ancillary_design: One count per generation and at most 40 lifetime response GETs per generation, not 40 per worker visit; .01 USD each as enforced by actual Batch2 campaign SQL. Zero cancels (forbidden). Read exhaustion retains partial/unknown outcomes; no blind resend.
costing.tools: Local/public tools unpriced; measured usage is not proved free or dollar billing. No paid auxiliary judge/search permitted.
